resources.string: One tap connects your Flipper as a Now Playing display for Apple Music. No account, no Internet, no listening history. Keep the helper running while you listen; reopen and tap Connect after reboot or force-stop.
Sideloaded apps may need the system App info → Allow restricted settings option before media access can be enabled. Media access is separate from ordinary notification visibility.
Tap Connect to grant Bluetooth access.
Tap Connect to enable media access, then return here — connection continues automatically.
Tap Connect to find your Flipper. Launch Apps → Bluetooth → Now Playing on the Flipper first.
Tap Connect to start. Then play a track in Apple Music.
Connected helper is running. Open the Now Playing app on your Flipper.
Looking for Now Playing on your Flipper… select it below. Scan stops automatically.
Scan failed (%1$d). Check Bluetooth and tap Connect to retry.
Flipper selected · %1$s. Starting… confirm the matching pairing code on both devices if asked.
Open Apple Music and play a track — it appears here and on your Flipper.
Enable Bluetooth and launch Now Playing on the Flipper
Now Playing is in Quick Settings. Tap to start or stop; hold to open setup.
Swipe down twice, tap Edit (the pencil), then add Now Playing to your Quick Settings tiles.
Could not start the helper. Check Bluetooth access, then tap Connect to retry.
